sources.targets: official: data/processed/target_feed.json (Target DSE Hybrid FINAL REBALANCING), 272 DSEs

rules.osa_amount: value (Rp) of SP + voucher (isi and blank) + saldo Mobo sell-in to DSE-mapped outlets whose combined value reaches Rp 300K in the period (GAPLOK OSA productivity rule); toggle: all outlets
rules.osa_target: official individual OSA target (IOH = IM3 + 3ID, rebalanced) from the target workbook; proxy = September full month only where a DSE has no official target
rules.sp_target: official Sell-In SP target in pcs per DSE (rebalanced), prorated MTD in the app
rules.sp_pcs: SP pcs sold in (all brands, all SP products) to DSE-mapped outlets; SP injection (digital, MOBO) is in spi_pcs / spi_amt / spi_out, MTD only; the app adds it to SP achievement (switch on by default)
rules.uar: DSE-mapped outlets with >= 5 SP pcs in the period
rules.effective_call: productive visits (executed visit with SP/VC qty > 0 or saldo > Rp 50K) / planned visits (fix PJP); toggle: executed visits
rules.class: urban/rural by branch rule (KARAWANG, KAB BEKASI = rural) unless the targets file gives U|R

uar.label: Outlet mapping sell in SP data >= 5 pcs
